conversation.speaker: doctor
conversation.message: Let's talk about your daily food habits to understand your nutrition better.

conversation.speaker: patient
conversation.message: Sure, I can share that.

conversation.speaker: doctor
conversation.message: How often do you eat white bread?

conversation.speaker: patient
conversation.message: I usually eat it every day for breakfast.

conversation.speaker: doctor
conversation.message: Noted. What about whole wheat bread?

conversation.speaker: patient
conversation.message: I take that maybe once a week, usually on weekends.

conversation.speaker: doctor
conversation.message: Great. Do you include oats in your diet?

conversation.speaker: patient
conversation.message: Yes, about five times a week, I have oats with milk in the mornings.

conversation.speaker: doctor
conversation.message: Good to know. How frequently do you eat rice?

conversation.speaker: patient
conversation.message: I have rice maybe twice a month, mostly when there is a special meal.

conversation.speaker: doctor
conversation.message: And do you consume rice bran in any form?

conversation.speaker: patient
conversation.message: Rarely, maybe occasionally in some multigrain flours.

conversation.speaker: doctor
conversation.message: What about maida, like in bakery products?

conversation.speaker: patient
conversation.message: I try to avoid it, so almost never.

conversation.speaker: doctor
conversation.message: Excellent choice. Do you eat dal regularly?

conversation.speaker: patient
conversation.message: Yes, dal is part of my lunch almost every day.

conversation.speaker: doctor
conversation.message: How often do you use rava or semolina in your meals?

conversation.speaker: patient
conversation.message: We make rava upma maybe once or twice a month.

conversation.speaker: doctor
conversation.message: Perfect, that gives me a good idea about your cereals and grains intake. Are there any changes you wish to make in your cereal choices?

conversation.speaker: patient
conversation.message: I’d like to reduce white bread and replace it with whole wheat bread or oats more often.

conversation.speaker: doctor
conversation.message: That sounds like a good plan.
